name: AD4 schedule gate (paste into an existing workflow)

nodes.name: Gate config
nodes.notes: Self-contained on purpose. The gate does not read your workflow's existing credential node, because it cannot know what you called it. Fill in the two boxes, and set `job` to the key this workflow uses in settings.workflow_schedules: P0.2_market_discovery, P0.3_book_volume_snapshot, P0.4_trade_history or P0.5_refresh_rules_text. The Check schedule node names the trigger nodes as `Schedule Trigger` and `Webhook Trigger`; rename those references if your workflow calls them something else. ($execution.mode is 'production' or 'test', never 'trigger', so it cannot tell a schedule from a button.)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ p_job: $('Gate config').first().json.job, p_trigger: $('Schedule Trigger').isExecuted ? "schedule" : ($('Webhook Trigger').isExecuted ? "webhook" : "manual") }) }}
